question: Within the frozen ICASSP2022 pure-far corpus, does public-DTD occupancy track source-domain render-coherent mic energy or the complementary non-render-coherent mic energy more strongly?

selection.rule: reuse exact frozen all-complete no-movement ICASSP2022 farend-singletalk inventory

geometry.delay_source: median production Sync estimated_delay_ms over far-active frames from unchanged predecessor provenance probe

observation_method.total_mic_render_ratio: Parseval-consistent source-domain mic spectral energy divided by delayed render spectral energy over fixed non-overlapping FFT segments
observation_method.coherent_mic_render_ratio: coherence-weighted mic spectral energy divided by render spectral energy
observation_method.incoherent_excess_mic_render_ratio: complementary (1-coherence)-weighted mic spectral energy divided by render spectral energy

prohibited_actions: interpret coherence-weighted terms as unique physical echo/noise decomposition
derive or apply source gain normalization
fit or apply an FIR or frequency-domain correction
search delay, FFT, tail, window, overlap, frequency band, threshold, or sample subset
change Sync, HPF, Activity, AEC, RES, NS, AGC, VAD, resampler, API, ABI, version, release, or shipping source
promote to source candidate, HIL, Product Certification, release, or shipping
interpretation_rule: The diagnostic may compare case-level associations of public-DTD occupancy with total, coherence-weighted, and complementary source-domain mic/render energy ratios. It cannot establish a unique physical decomposition or authorize normalization or detector changes.
